free_tier.stated: Free: 'You can upload up to 10 GB files, for free!'. No free total-storage figure published anywhere on the site.

egress.terms: Free downloads are throttled and ad-gated; no free CDN path, no published allowance.

tooling: JDownloader, Mipony and other multihost downloaders; no documented open API.
chaining: 10 GB per file with no stated total — chaining is bounded by an unpublished retention policy, so it cannot be sized.
limits_note: 10 GB per file free. Retention not published on the pages reachable (its /faq and /pricing paths both return 404). Paid = 10 GB/day, 100 GB/day on Max, per the sister brand TezFiles.
reliability_note: The canonical /pricing and /faq URLs 404 on nginx, so any scraper or blog citing 'Nitroflare limits at /pricing' is pointing at a dead path. Numbers here come from the homepage meta only.

evidence.proved: 'You can upload up to 10 GB files, for free!'
probe: GET /pricing -> 404 Not Found (nginx); GET /faq -> 404 Not Found
